texts.zh: 我们可以定位这个神秘通讯的源头。通过信号的追踪我们发现了许多不同的坐标点，我们确定这是来自一个移动物体上的通讯。我们的理论认为我们应该是与一艘舰船发生了通讯，一艘可能用于自然保留地之类作用的舰船。
texts.en: We were able to locate the source of the mysterious transmissions. On tracing the signals to multiple points of origin, we have ascertained they must be coming from a moving object. Our leading theory suggests we were contacted by a ship, which may be used as a nature reserve of sorts.

texts.zh:
有人尝试与我们建立通讯。

我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。
texts.en:
Someone is trying to establish contact with us.

We hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.

texts.zh:
又有人尝试联络我们。

我们又一次听到了之前生物群系的声音。但还是没有任何人出现。
texts.en:
Someone is attempting to contact us again.

We hear the sounds of the biome from earlier. Still, nobody is present.

label.en: Trace the source of the transmission.
This is a waste of time.

texts.zh:
我们建立了通讯，然后再一次听到了那个生物群系熟悉的声音。然而，这次我们听到了人的说话声，

诚挚地向你们问好，[owner.GetAdjective]！我对你们有所期待。原谅我的唐突，但我必须知道你们有多少好奇心。现在让我问你一件事。你们如何看待生命?
texts.en:
We establish communication, and are met with the now familiar sounds of the biome. However, this time we hear someone speaking,

Warm greetings, [owner.GetAdjective]! I've been expecting you. Pardon the pretense, but I had to know how curious you were. Now let me ask you something. How do you value life?

label.zh: 那要看情况。毕竟生命有很多不同的形式。
label.en: That depends. Life comes in many forms.

label.zh: 这是什么脑筋急转弯吗？

texts.zh:
挺合理的回答。几乎所有人都会毫不犹豫地摘除可能危及自己生命的东西。但是我们要记住，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，我来解释一下我联系你的原因。
texts.en:
A sensible answer. Few would hesitate to remove something that would threaten life. Yet, it bears remembering that all life holds infinite potential.

Now, I will shed some light on my reason for contacting you.

texts.zh:
这位植物类叹了口气。

终于见到了一个脑子里不只想着征服的民族。我也有同感，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，请允许我解释一下我联系您的原因。
texts.en:
The plantoid sighs.

At last, a people with more than conquest on their minds. I share your sentiment. All life holds infinite potential.

Now, allow me to explain my reason for contacting you.

texts.zh:
我叫艾莎琳，是来自艾莎提亚的一位前太空生物学家 后来成为了太空创生学者。我一直寻找可以创造新生命的材料。太空创生学需要的能量远超过我自己所能产生的。

艾莎琳顿了顿，继续说道

请相信我，这是物有所值的。但一开始有些困难。我想先送你一份礼物，看看你能否中和它。
texts.en:
I am Azaryn, a former astrobiologist from Azathea turned scholar of astrocreation. I seek the materials needed to create new life. Astrocreation requires more energy than I can generate on my own.

Azaryn pauses before continuing,

I assure you, this is a worthwhile pursuit. But first, a challenge. I would like to send you a gift of sorts. See if you are able to neutralize it.

texts.zh:
我是一个来自艾莎提亚的前太空生物学家， 后来成为了太空创生学者。我一直寻找可以创造新生命的材料。太空创生学需要的能量远超过我自己所能产生的。

艾莎琳顿了顿，继续说道

请相信我，这是物有所值的。但一开始有些困难。我想先送你一份礼物，看看你能否中和它。
texts.en:
I am a former astrobiologist from Azathea, turned scholar of astrocreation. I seek the materials needed to create new life. Astrocreation requires more energy than I can generate on my own.

Azaryn pauses before continuing,

I assure you, this is a worthwhile pursuit. But first, a challenge. I would like to send you a gift of sorts. See if you are able to neutralize it.

texts.zh:
我们对艾莎琳的有机“礼物”取得了一定的进展。跨学科科学进步日益增长的潜力令人鼓舞。

我们整理好了目前为止的发现，消除了该微生物的任何潜在威胁，并准备好再次联系艾莎琳。
texts.en:
We have made progress with Azaryn's organic 'gift'. The growing potential for interdisciplinary scientific advancement is encouraging.

We have collated our findings, having neutralized any potential threat from the microorganism, and we are ready to contact Azaryn again.

texts.zh:
艾莎琳听到我们的进展非常开心。

太棒了！我非常感激，并为你们的努力喝彩。那么，[owner.GetName]，我还有另一个问题。

你会为了逃避死亡而夺取另一个人的生命吗？
texts.en:
Azaryn is delighted to hear of our breakthrough.

Wonderful! I appreciate and applaud your efforts. Now, [owner.GetName], I have another question.

To escape death, would you take the life of another?

texts.zh:
确实，大多数人都会这么选。毕竟生存是所有生物的驱动力。理解并接受这个事实也许有一天能拯救你，还有你的良心。

在我的下一个请求之前，我还有一件礼物要给你们。这是艾莎提亚大王花，是一种我的舰船上原生的花卉。我给你的挑战是让它开花。暂时再会了。
texts.en:
Indeed, most would. Survival is the driving force of all living things, after all. Understanding and accepting that fact might save you one day, and your conscience.

Before my next query, I have another gift for you. It is a Rafflesia Azathea, a type of flower, native to my ship. I challenge you to make it bloom. Farewell, for now.

texts.zh:
真的，你们真的不会吗？

艾莎琳挠了挠头。

我觉得这让人有点沮丧，也不可信。虽然我觉得这在某种程度上是令人钦佩的。要是这是真的就好了。

在我的下一个请求之前，我还有一件礼物要给你们。这是艾莎提亚大王花，是一种我的舰船上原生的花卉。我给你的挑战是让它开花。暂时再会了。
texts.en:
Truly, you would not?

Azaryn scratches her head.

I find that discouraging, and rather unconvincing. Although I suppose it's admirable in a way. If only it were true.

Before my next query, I have another gift for you. It is a Rafflesia Azathea, a type of flower, native to my ship. I challenge you to make it bloom. Farewell, for now.

texts.zh: 我们最初试图引起花苞的反应，但效果并不好。只有当使用超出通常安全参数的电刺激时，这朵花才能开放。我们已经完成了艾莎琳的最新任务，并准备再次与她联系。
texts.en: Our initial attempts to provoke a reaction from the flower bud were underwhelming. It was only when we applied electrical stimuli beyond our usual safety parameters that we were able to bring the flower to bloom. We have completed Azaryn's latest task, and are ready to contact her again.

texts.zh:
一只小巧的授粉无人机在艾莎琳的脑边嗡嗡作响。她温柔地把它挥开。

再次问好。艾莎提亚大王花真是一种有趣的植物，你们也赞同吧？进化真是一件奇妙的事情。我对于你们能对其施加合适量的能量来使其盛开感到印象深刻。

她兴奋地拍起了手。

又到了提问时间。在规模都很大的前提下，你们会为了拯救其他的生命而牺牲自己的同类吗？
texts.en:
A tiny pollination drone buzzes around Azaryn's head. She gently wafts it away.

Hello again. The Rafflesia Azathea sure is an interesting plant, wouldn't you agree? Evolution truly is a wondrous thing. I'm impressed you were able to apply the required amount of energy to make it bloom.

She claps her hands excitedly.

Time for another question. Would you sacrifice your own kind if it meant you could save lives elsewhere, on a massive scale?

texts.zh:
艾莎琳心领神会地点了点头。

是的，也许这个答案很明显，但在那个场景之下，可能很难看到正确答案。我们必须抛下自己的情感，做出那些顾全大局的事情。

我再问你们最后一个问题。

你们在消灭威胁的时候会有任何迟疑吗？
texts.en:
Azaryn nods in understanding.

Yes, it may seem the obvious choice but, when caught up in the moment, it can be very hard to see it through. We must set aside our emotions and do what is best for the greater good.

I have one final question for you.

Would you hesitate to remove a threat?

texts.zh:
艾莎琳同情地点了点头。

确实，这不是一件容易的事。我赞许你们的诚实。

然而我相信，为了顾全大局，智慧生命必须给那些无私的选择以更高的优先级。

我再问你们最后一个问题。

你们在消灭威胁的时候会有任何迟疑吗？
texts.en:
Azaryn nods sympathetically.

Indeed, it is not an easy thing to do. I appreciate your honesty.

However, it is my belief that for the betterment of all, intelligent life must always give precedence to the selfless choice.

I have one final question for you.

Would you hesitate to remove a threat?

label.zh: 没错。决定性的行为确实需要三思。

texts.zh:
你喜欢有时间思考。不幸的是，有时间思考可是一种特权。决定是一定有做出的，而片刻的深思熟虑可能是成功与失败的区别。

艾莎琳沉默片刻，然后给出了结论：

很好，我已经问了你们够多问题了。你们给予了我非常多的耐心。我会花一点时间收集这些信息。我们很快会再一次谈话的。
texts.en:
Ah, you like having time to think. Unfortunately, one does not always have the privilege of extra time. Decisions must be made, and a moment of deliberation could be the difference between success and failure.

Azaryn is quiet for a moment. Then concludes:

Well, I have asked you enough questions. You possess admirable patience. I will take some time to collate this information. We shall speak again soon.

texts.zh:
我同意。果断很重要，但有些情况需要额外考虑。有时候你并不总是那么幸运，能够马上获得所有必要的信息。耐心对你大有好处。

艾莎琳沉默片刻，然后给出了结论：

很好，我已经问了你们够多问题了。你们给予了我非常多的耐心。我会花一点时间收集这些信息。我们很快会再一次谈话的。
texts.en:
I agree. Decisiveness is vital, but some situations require extra consideration. Sometimes you are not fortunate enough to have all of the necessary information right away. Patience could benefit you greatly.

Azaryn is quiet for a moment. Then concludes:

Well, I have asked you enough questions. You possess admirable patience. I will take some time to collate this information. We shall speak again soon.

texts.zh:
啊，[owner.GetAdjective]。诚挚地向你们问好。我的结论是，你们是太空创生学杰出的继承人！

艾莎琳微笑着。

我们将携手将生命播撒向虚空。我们将携手为所有人带去希望！

 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
texts.en:
Ah, [owner.GetAdjective]. Warm greetings. I have concluded that you are an excellent advocate for astrocreation!

Azaryn smiles.

Together we shall breathe life into the void. Together, we shall inspire hope for all!

As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

texts.zh:
你好，[owner.GetAdjective]。很高兴再次见到你们。

尽管我们有许多的不同，但我希望你们能记得我的教导，并学会用创生学的知识造福星系。

 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
texts.en:
Hello, [owner.GetAdjective]. I am pleased to see you again.

Despite our differences, it is my hope that you will embrace my teaching, and learn to utilize astrocreation for the good of the galaxy.

As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

texts.zh:
你好！你们已经向我展示了你们的实力。我希望能适时教会你们利用我的太空创生之力。

艾莎琳鞠了一躬。

我们会携手让星系再度变得郁郁葱葱。 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
texts.en:
Hello again! You have proven your potential. In time I hope to teach you to utilize my astrocreation powers.

Azaryn bows.

Together, we will reinvigorate the galaxy.As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

label.zh: 所以太空创生学到底是什么？
所以太空创生学到底是什么？

label.en: What are those things on your back?

label.zh: 你那台嗡嗡作响的小无人机是什么？
label.en: What is that buzzing, tiny drone of yours?

texts.zh:
艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 为了纪念此刻的愉悦，请接收这份信息素作为礼物。里面包含了一些可以为你的人民带去好处的化合物。很值得一用。
texts.en:
Typing quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. To mark this joyous occasion, please accept this gift of pheromones. They contain a potent compound which will bring certain benefits to your people. It is well deserved.

texts.zh:
艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 为了纪念我们的合作，我准备了一份信息素作为礼物。这不是我最杰出的工作，但还是会为你们的人民带来一些正面的效果。
texts.en:
Typing quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. To commemorate our collaboration, I have prepared a gift of pheromones. It's not my best work, but they will provide some positive effects to your people.

texts.zh:
艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。 感觉我给你这些信息素应该挺合适的。它们与你们的物种可以兼容，一定能提供一些正面效果的。
texts.en:
Typing quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones. It seems appropriate I give you these pheromones. They are compatible with your species, and are sure to provide some positive effects.

texts.zh: 我们应该能追踪到这个怪异通讯的源头。
texts.en: We may be able to trace the source of the anonymous transmissions we have been receiving.

texts.zh: 我们从艾莎琳那里收到的所谓礼物实际上是一种植物性细菌，且与我们所见过的任何细菌都不同。中和它将会是一个危险的挑战。然而，如果我们成功了，它将进一步加深我们对科学和医学的理解。
texts.en: The supposed gift we received from Azaryn is in fact a plant-based bacteria, unlike anything we've ever seen. Neutralizing it will provide a dangerous challenge. However, if we are successful, it would further our understanding of science and medicine.

texts.zh: 艾莎琳给我们一个任务，让我们尝试让一朵在她船上生态系统原生的巨大的花苞开花。基于初步的观测，这朵花可能对太空生物学有着极为重要的意义。
texts.en: Azaryn has tasked us with blooming a giant flower bud, native to her dome ship's ecosystem. Based on initial observations, this flower may be of great astrobiological significance.
